items.title: Oregon Coast Native Lands 1828
items.note: The creator’s own sketch map of the coastal homelands as of 1828 — Siuslaw, Quuiich, Hanis, Miluk — with the tidewater reaches and a few landmarks. Signed “Zybach 20230731.”
items.author: Bob Zybach

items.title: Large-scale map of the memorial ground, sheet 1
items.note: A large-scale map of the ground on which the memorial stands and in which the graves lie. The creator’s own file name for it is a place name, so the name is withheld with the map.
items.author: Vyla Grindberg, Douglas County GIS, with Bob Zybach

items.title: Large-scale map of the memorial ground, sheet 2
items.note: A large-scale map of the same ground, and the same reason for withholding the file name.
items.author: Vyla Grindberg, Douglas County GIS, with Bob Zybach

items.title: Field map accompanying the 4 May 2023 canine search report
items.note: The field map that goes with the search report — by Cathy Schneider, Northwest Canine Resources. A third-party work, and a map of where a cadaver dog alerted.
items.author: Cathy Schneider, Northwest Canine Resources
